copy.description: Files to materialize before bootstrap; non-empty lists require an effective command.

anyOf.description: Copy this relative path to the same destination.

from.description: Source relative to the canonical root, absolute, or beginning with ~/.

anyOf.description: A worktree-relative destination that stays inside the worktree after normalization.

items.description: A worktree-relative destination that stays inside the worktree after normalization.

copy_mode_default.description: Default copy mode; falls back to copy. Explicitly setting it requires an effective command.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the expanded root's basename.

pool_size.description: Fixed pool size; requires an effective bootstrap command.

command.description: Bootstrap command run under bash; omitted values inherit from earlier layers.

pre_remote_check.description: Bash command run before remote operations.

worktree_location.description: Override the inherited placement for new worktrees.

policy.description: Start from origin's default branch or first fast-forward the canonical checkout.

delete_branch.description: Delete its branch; requires remove_worktree in the effective policy. Default: false.

push.description: Push before cleanup; built-in default: false.

remove_worktree.description: Remove the checkout after integration; built-in default: false.

description: Repository-local .wktree.toml at the canonical root. Explicit fields override global settings; omitted fields inherit them.
